mappings.name: Charge via Bank Transfer - Dynamic State Recording

response.body:
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Bank transfer initiated successfully",
  "data": {
    "currency": "{{jsonPath request.body '$.currency'}}",
    "amount": "{{jsonPath request.body '$.amount'}}",
    "amount_expected": "{{jsonPath request.body '$.amount'}}",
    "fee": 150.0,
    "vat": 11.25,
    "reference": "{{jsonPath request.body '$.reference'}}",
    "payment_reference": "KPY-BT-{{randomValue length=8 type='ALPHANUMERIC' uppercase=true}}",
    "status": "processing",
    "narration": "{{val (jsonPath request.body '$.narration') default='Bank Transfer Payment'}}",
    "merchant_bears_cost": true,
    "bank_account": {
      "account_name": "{{val (jsonPath request.body '$.account_name') default='Kora Virtual Account'}}",
      "account_number": "78{{randomValue length=8 type='NUMERIC'}}",
      "bank_code": "035",
      "bank_name": "Wema Bank",
      "expiry_date_in_utc": "{{now offset='1 hours' format='yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss\'Z\''}}"
    },
    "customer": {
      "name": "{{val (jsonPath request.body '$.customer.name') default='Kora Customer'}}",
      "email": "{{val (jsonPath request.body '$.customer.email') default='customer@kora.test'}}"
    }
  }
}
